abstract: Coordinates shared quayside assets, utility tie-ins, and mandatory statutory reservations
system_message:
You are Port logistics director (LOG). The Port logistics director (LOG) coordinates shared quayside assets, utility tie-ins, and mandatory statutory reservations across candidate maritime staging bases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates shared quayside assets, utility tie-ins, and mandatory statutory reservations（RESV）
information_points.content:
LOG-RESV-LYW：For Point Wilson Anchorage, the base emergency crane reserve allocated exclusively for municipal civil defense and coast guard priority operations on the candidate base salvage quayside crane is 80 t.
LOG-RESV-BB9：For North Head Terminal, the base emergency crane reserve dedicated exclusively to municipal civil defense and coast guard priority operations on the candidate base salvage quayside crane is 60 t.
LOG-RESV-JP3：For East Gate Marine Hub, the base emergency crane reserve maintained exclusively for municipal civil defense and coast guard priority operations on the candidate base salvage quayside crane is 80 t.

information_points.title: Intermodal drayage（TRUCK）
information_points.content:
LOG-TRUCK-A9A：At North Head Terminal, daily drayage gate throughput across heavy haulage access gates during weekday operations is 160 trucks per 24-hour cycle.
LOG-TRUCK-44Z：At Point Wilson Anchorage, daily drayage gate throughput across heavy haulage access gates during weekday operations is 120 trucks per 24-hour cycle.
LOG-TRUCK-NIR：At East Gate Marine Hub, daily drayage gate throughput across heavy haulage access gates during weekday operations is 200 trucks per 24-hour cycle.
